Between the Nov 7 snapshot and the latest one (Nov 20), there were 131 new postings. The filter kept 16 of them. These are the top 5 by score:

| # | Title | Company | Location | Matched skills |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Machine Learning Data Scientist, Forecasting Platform](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/5467893008) (score 6.5) | Anthropic | San Francisco, CA | Python, SQL, AWS |
| 2 | [Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Cybersecurity Products)](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Perplexity/b23d83e3-add8-48ea-b16e-65a956d1192c) (5.5) | Perplexity | San Francisco | Python, AWS |
| 3 | [Growth GTM Engineer, Revenue Operations](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Perplexity/e916f0c8-5a31-4bb6-b4e3-7c4a64b95fda) (5.5) | Perplexity | San Francisco | Python, SQL |
| 4 | [Software Engineer, Datacenter Server Lifecycle](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/5484171008) (5.5) | Anthropic | Remote-Friendly, United States | Python, AWS |
| 5 | [Member of Technical Staff (AI Software Engineer, Agent Engine)](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Perplexity/10a51134-6741-40ec-8cca-a8ac1534673b) (4.5) | Perplexity | San Francisco | Python |

**Boards with no result:** two boards returned nothing in this comparison, so their postings aren't reflected above.
- `ashby:notion-does-not-exist-js2` failed with an HTTP 404, which is permanent and wasn't retried.
- `ashby:openai` timed out. That error is transient, and it was retried once.

The other boards, Anthropic and Perplexity, did return results. Notion's board isn't in the list of failures. The 404 board has a different name, so I can't say whether Notion postings were covered.

The Datacenter Server Lifecycle posting has a mismatch. The title says "Software Engineer", but the snippet describes a "Staff Engineer" role.
